expected: Preserve populated string columns unless the requested transformation requires changing them; handle pandas string dtypes correctly.
defect: Generated data-wrangling code corrupts populated bike_model/date text values during numeric coercion, returning missing or invalid values.
Root cause: ARCHIVED OBSERVATION, NOT A NEW EXECUTION. In the documented failure family, generated code recognizes text via object/category checks and coerces other columns to numeric; pandas 3 string columns can therefore become NaN. This is generated code, not a fixed numeric-coercion statement in the repository. Exact branch attribution requires the individual generated-code trace. Run 6725869d1dd44d348760ba0567b405e4 (original), relevant step 7. In step-7 the generated wrangling code only treats object/category columns as text and runs pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce') on everything else, turning every bike_model value into NaN and flagging all 13149 rows as missing. Observed response excerpt: Wrangled table shape: 13149 rows x 10 cols.  Returning the data table:           date  bike_model  price  quantity_sold  extended_sales  has_missing_flag  extended_sales_mismatch_flag  price_negative_flag  quantity_sold_ Trace: trajectory/.
